review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines the iteration of a SuccStruct as a colimit of `iterationFunctor`. It builds on the existing `colimit`, `Cocone`, `IsWellOrderContinuous`, `TransfiniteCompositionOfShape` and `restrictionLT`, so it reuses Mathlib's notions. The closest other Mathlib development is `Mathlib/Order/TransfiniteIteration.lean` (`transfiniteIterate`). It iterates an order self-map on a preorder, not a successor structure in a category. That is a different concept and works at a different level, so I found no competing duplicate. I found no other Mathlib definition of the categorical transfinite iteration. The named wrappers (`iterationCocone`, `isColimitIterationCocone`, `ιIteration`) are thin, useful names, not redundant concepts.
